tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje phur pa sa lugs kyi sbyin sreg rdo rje'i me 'od bzhugs so// na maḥshrī badz+ra ku mā rā ya/ bla ma mchog dang lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje gzhon nu la btud nas/ /bsnyen pa kha gso la sogs pa'i/ /zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bshad par bya/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa sa lugs kyi bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sgrub pa la don gsum ste/ sbyor ba dang / dngos gzhi dang / rjes kyi cho ga'o/ /dang po la ni/ ji ltar 'os pa'i sa phyogs su/ stegs bu 'dom gang gru bzhi pa'i steng du/ zhi ba'i thab spyi dang mthun par bris pa'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bcu/ dbus dang phyogs bcur lha'i mtshan ma/ me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ 'khor lo'i phyi thab kyi nang du/ sgo ma bzhi'i tshom bu bshams/ kha khyer gyi steng du bud shing lag len ltar brtsig shar lhor ting lo sdong bu mar dang bcas pa bzhag rnal 'byor pa'i g.yas su bsreg rdzas/ g.yon du mchod rdzas/ mdun du me yol/ rdo rje dril bu'i bar du/ dgang gzar kha sbyar/ nang mchod/ ḍa ma ru/ bsang chu 'thor yab dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang ku sha/ spor lde/ bud shing / rol mo'i cha byad sogs dang / g.yon phyogs su gtor ma gsum mam ji ltar 'byor pa bshams la/ rang nyid kha shar du bltas te brgyan gos dkar po dang / zhi ba'i sems kyis dkyil dkrung ngam tsog pur 'dug gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa/ 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'o/ /dang po ni mdun gyi dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel na/ sgrub thabs yang snying lhan skyes ltar bzlas pa bsdu ba'i bar rdzogs par bsgom la/ bsang chu la nang mchod rdo rje'i rtses gtor nas/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li hūm̐ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las shaṃ las byung ba'i dung phor mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i nang du/

hūm̐ las byung ba'i bsang chu dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ thab dang yo byad thabs cad kyi 'bags pa dang / ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ gong gi 'khyil pa'i sngags nyer gcig bzlas/ de nas thab dang yo byad rnams la ku sha'i 'thor yab kyis/ bsang chu gtor nas/ 'khyil pa'i sngags dang / swa bhā was bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi kā pa la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ las lha rdzas kyi mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdugs spos mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bu dang / bsreg rdzas rnams kyang gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba/ zhi ba'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ā ha ra li hūm̐ nas/ bispū ra ya hūm̐ gi bar dang / oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+riṃ swā hā/ oṃ oṃ swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ gnyis pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ yang thab la bsang chu gtor nas 'khyil pa'i sngags dang / swa bhā was bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po/ rgyar khru gang / zabs su khru phyed/ kha khyer dang mu ran la rdo rjes mtshan zhing / phyi rol stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes rgyan pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa bud shing rtsig pa dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ raṃ las bgrang phreng / raṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ me lha sku mdog dmar po 'od zer dkar po 'phro zhing 'du ba/ ra skyes la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas bgrang phreng dang / g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa gsus khyim che ba/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / sma ra'i ag tshoms can/ drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ shar phyogs nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dbyug gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna drung du g.yab cing / oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad bsgrub pa po/ /thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa/ /'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ag+na ye ma hā te dza sarba kā ma pra sā dha ka ma hā bhū ta de ba ṛ ṣi dwi dza sat+ta ma gṛ hi twa/ kā ru ṇi ka sarba sat+t+wā+ār+tha kṛ twā/ ā hu ti/ ā hā ra/ asmin+da san+ni/ hi to bha ba/ pad+ma ka ma la yā satwaṃ/ oṃ ag+ne ya sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra a na la mahā bhū ta/ dz+wā lā ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭā+e bhasmin+da ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ tṛ sh+ya ho/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ ces dam la bzhag oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi ṇi hūm̐ dza sogs kyi dgug gzhug bya/ slar yang rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros dbang gi lha khro bo rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la dbang bskur ba bstsal du gsol/ oṃ badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad la bsang chu gtor nas/ bsang sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa/ 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge/ /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin/ /'dis bdag cag gi bgegs dang / mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing las kyi dngos sgrub stsal du gsol/

oṃ badz+ra sa twa ā/ zhes pas ku sha rtse mo g.yas skor du thab kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du dbul/ de nas sbyin sreg gi gzhung rnams su gong du me sbor bar bshad kyang / lag len la skabs 'dir byed pas/ spor lde sbar nas thab la g.yas su lan gsum bskor zhing / kī la ya brjod/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wā la dz+wā raṃ zhes pas thab kyi nang gi ting lo sbar zhing / de nas yam shing gzhan dang bcas pas me legs par 'bar du bcug cing mar dgang blug gsum dang / dz+wā la'i sngags kyis me gso/ de nas/ me lha'i lce hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang / dgang blug gi kha la raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye di bya di bya bi shud+dhe ma hā shrī ye/ ha bya/ ka bya/ ba ha na ya/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib/ dam tshig nyams chag sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis byon zan dbul/ dgang blug kha sbyar la thab la lan gsum bskor/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ pā d+yaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis phyi mchod/ nang mchod mtheb srin gyi gtor la/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'jig rten dbang phyug༞ ces sogs kyis bstod/ de nas bsreg rdzas dbul ba ni/ yam shing la oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ya swā hā/ mar la/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ til la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya swā hā/ 'bras la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ya swā hā/ zas mchog la/ oṃ sarba sam+pa de swā hā/ so ba la/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza yā ya swā hā/ nas la/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ sran ma la/ oṃ ma hā ba la ya swā hā/ gro la/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ya swā hā/ durba la/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ ku sha la/ oṃ badz+ra a pra ti ha ta badz+rā ya swā hā/ re re la'ang sngags lan bdun re'i mjug tu spel tshig gong bzhin bsreg rdzas kyang bdun re'o/ /de rjes bsang chu nas me nang du cung zad blug la/ oṃ prok+ṣa ṇaṃ añtsa ma naṃ pra tits+tsha swā hā/

zhes pas bsang gtor dang / zhabs bsil phul/ mar blug gzar gang thab nang du blug la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wā la raṃ/ me lha 'bar pa'i rnam par gyur/ gsum pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ slar me gso ba'i phyir bud shing rtsig pa dang / mchod pa bsregs rdzas rnams kha cung zad gsos la/ 'khyil pa'i sngags dang oṃ mahā shū n+ya ta sogs dang / oṃ dharma dhā tu sogs kyis thab dang me bsang sbyangs/ rdo rje khro bos zhe sdang gcod/ /sogs nas/ ma draṃ dza'i bar sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhin dang / gdan de rnams kyi steng du hūm̐ sgril ma bcu gcig dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ rnams las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshul 'dus yongs su gyur pa las dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs su gyur pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sogs dang / dbus su dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal nas/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ oṃ dīp+tā sogs dang / yum chen 'khor lo nas yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud pas bzhugs/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ kā ra sogs nas/ dam can dbang phyug ma bskyed pa'i bar/ lha sta gon gyi skabs ji lta ba bzhin dam tshig pa bskyed/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dmigs med mkha' ltar zhes sogs kyis spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi ṇi hūm̐ dzaḥ ye shes pa bcug lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying khar hūm̐/ de rnams las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje 'bru gsum gyi rnam par byung ba/ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ thabs kyi spyod pa sogs kyis dbang bskur bas/ gtso 'khor gzhan thams cad la khro bo rigs lnga dang / dam can dbang phyug ma rnams la rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa phyed pa res dbu brgyan/ de nas byon zan 'bul ba ni kī la ya'i rjes su ag+na ye sogs spel tshig dang bcas pa lan bdun dbul/

slar yang mchod pa dang bsreg rdzas rnams gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs/ sgeg phreng sogs phyi mchod dang / rang byung gdod nas sogs dang / rgyal ba kun dngos sogs kyi nang mchod/ 'khril ba'i mchod chen sogs kyi gsang mchod/ mnyam pa'i sgrub rdzas sogs de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa/ dam tshig chen po sogs/ gdab kha dang pos bsgral mchod/ he ru ka'i gnas bcu dang sogs rak+ta'i mchod pa/ nga ni za byed chen po sogs khams gsum yongs bsgral gyi mchod pa dang / bla med mchog gi sogs gtor ma'i mchod pa/ sgeg cing dpa' dang sogs bstod pa yang snying lhan skyes bzhin bya'o/ /de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba'i go rim gong bzhin la sngags rnams kī la ya 'ba' zhig gis 'bul/ bsnyen pa kha gso'i skabs su til yungs kar gang rung la bcu cha'i grangs 'dzin zhing spel tshig gong ltar bya/ skabs skabs su me gso ba'i phyir yam shing dang mar ji ltar rigs pa 'bul bsreg rdzas gzhan rnams brgya rtsa re 'bul dgos pa dus gcig la phul na me mi 'bar ba'i skyon yong bas/ skabs su gang bab re 'bul/ mthar mar gyi gang ba'i sbyin sreg lan bdun sngags spel tshig gong ltar bya/ de nas phyi mchod/ nang mchod bstod pa'i mchod pa rnams gong du bshad pa bzhin dang / yi dam chos skyong gzhan la'ang so so'i gtor chog bzhin 'bul/ de nas ye shes lnga ldan sogs kyi 'dod don gsol btab/ yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum dang / /ma 'byor ba dang sogs bzod gsol/ /khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /sogs kyis thab kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyi thal ba blangs la dpral bar reg go /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mar blugs gzar gang thab du blug la oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ me lha zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa'i sku can du gyur/ de nas bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams so so'i sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa bdun re dbul/

slar yang mar gyi gang ba'i sbyin sreg bdun phul la mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ gtor ma gsum pa nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la 'khyil pa'i sngags dang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul la phyi mchod nang mchod gong bzhin dang bstod pa ni/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs dang / tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /sogs kyis bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la sogs kyis 'dod don gsol/ gong bzhin bsang gtor dang / zhabs bsil phul la/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /sogs dang / oṃ ag+na ye yahi gats+tsha/ spyan drangs pa'i phyag rgya phyir bkrol te ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang / go cha bgo ba dang / lhag chad kyi mtha' bsal ba bsngo ba smon lam/ bkra shis sogs sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o/ /sbyin sreg gi dus 'dir me'i dkyil mi dkrug phus mi gdab/ me ma shi bar g.yo 'gul mi bya/ bud shing yam shing sogs bsreg rdzas rnams la mi 'gom/ me lha drang srong yin pas gtsang sbra la gnas par bya'o/ /'di'i ngag 'don kha skong dgos pa/ rje bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i dkyil chog tu shes par bya'o/ /rang gzhan sdig sgrib dag pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje phur pa'i sbyin sreg gi/ /cho ga rdo rje'i me 'od 'di/ /dpal ldan sa skya lo tsa ba/ /ā nan+da yis 'bad pas sbyar/ /dge bas 'gro kun sdug bsngal gyi/ /tshang tshing mun pa kun bcom nas/ /kun tu bzang po'i dpal thob shog /ces pa 'di ni don gnyer 'ga' zhig gis bskul ba'i ngor/ dpal sa skya lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos kun gsal bde chen gling du sbyar ba dge legs 'phel//
